summary.text: Henry Emele is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 26, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Emele described himself as a husband, father, small-business owner and Manchester resident.

paragraphs.text: In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Henry Emele said he is running to serve the people of Ward 7 in Manchester and that his business experience taught him the importance of fiscal responsibility.

Emele listed supporting responsible state budgets and opposing unnecessary tax increases, supporting police, firefighters and first responders, and reducing barriers for small businesses and housing construction among his priorities.
